name: Tickline
summary: A chat composer whose message flies into the thread and earns clock, sent, delivered and seen ticks
about: A friendly chat card with a real message box and a round Send button. Your text lifts out of the field as a bubble and flies up into the thread while older messages glide aside, then a spinning clock turns into one tick, two ticks and finally mint seen ticks as a tiny avatar hops down to your message. Zara types back, replies and drops a heart on it. Made for chat widgets, support boxes and messaging apps.
how: Type a message and press Enter or the Send button. An empty box makes the field shake and shows a hint.
The button squashes, its arrow shoots off and the text flies up into the thread as a bubble.
A small clock spins while sending, then one tick draws for Sent and a second for Delivered.
The ticks glow mint for Seen, and the seen avatar hops from the last read message to the new one.
Zara's status rolls to typing, the dots bounce, her reply springs in and a heart pops on your bubble.
